personality: 7 Dark-First Utility with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A premium, cinematic fitness command center that uses deep dark glass surfaces, neon accents, and oversized metrics to motivate performance.

color.theme_support: Implement a theme switcher for 7 themes: Orange (Default), Blue, Red, Green, Purple, Pink, AMOLED Black. The structure above defines the Default Orange theme. For others, swap `brandPrimary`, `brandSecondary`, and `brandTertiary` hues respectively. For AMOLED Black, set `surface`, `surfaceSecondary`, and `surfaceTertiary` to `#000000` with structural borders.

spacing.rule: Use generous vertical padding for sections, but keep internal card spacing dense and structural. Oversize metrics need breathing room.

do's: Use expo-blur heavily for all cards (surfaceSecondary) over the #050505 background to create the 'Dark Glassmorphism' effect.
Apply subtle glowing shadows (using react-native-shadow-2 or similar) around active elements and the circular step ring.
Ensure text on glass cards remains #FFFFFF with high opacity for readability.
dont's: Don't use glassmorphism on tiny elements like chips or badges; use solid brandTertiary instead.
Don't blur the main background itself; keep the background #050505 solid or with a very subtle dark gradient.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce the app with premium 3D fitness artwork and a glowing orange theme.

states.loading: Dark screen with a glowing orange pulse.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim. Walking/running animation or 3D art centered. Large typography at the bottom (Rajdhani). Primary CTA 'Get Started' is a wide pill button with a soft orange shadow (glow), and a secondary 'Skip' text button.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: The main dashboard visualizing daily progress via a large glowing circular step ring and modular stat cards.

states.empty: No data yet - 'Take your first steps today!' with an empty ring.
states.error: Failed to load data, show retry button.

screens.layout: Header: 'Hi Guest' greeting + notifications/settings icons. Top section: Large glowing circular step ring (use react-native-svg with stroke animation and shadow for neon glow effect). Center the steps (12,458) inside. Middle section: 2x2 grid of glassmorphism cards (Calories, Distance, Hydration, Sleep) with 28dp radius. Bottom section: Weekly Progress mini line chart and Daily Goals checklist. A 'Reset Today's Data' text link at the very bottom.

screens.name: Steps
screens.purpose: Detailed view of step history with charts and insights.

states.empty: No steps logged for this period.

screens.layout: Top: Segmented control (Day/Week/Month) with glass background. Center: Large total steps metric (57,729) in Rajdhani, followed by a tall orange bar chart. Bottom: Scrollable list of insights cards (Total Distance, Calories, Active Time) in dark glass cards.

screens.name: Workout
screens.purpose: Start and track live workouts (Walking, Running, Cycling, Custom).
screens.layout: Horizontal scrollable list of workout types at the top. Large central circular 'Start' button with an intense orange neon glow. Below, a glass card showing current session metrics (Duration, Distance, Calories) or recent history. When active, metrics take over the full screen with Rajdhani font for high legibility.

screens.name: Habits
screens.purpose: Track daily lifestyle goals via a checklist.
screens.layout: Vertical list of habit cards (Drink Water, Sleep Goal, Workout, Walk Goal). Each card is a glass surface with a left-aligned icon, center text + streak count, and a right-aligned custom checkbox (circular, fills with brandPrimary and glows when checked).

screens.name: Body
screens.layout: Form layout with large, touch-friendly glassmorphism cards for each input (Gender, Birth Year, Weight, Height, Step Length). Use custom wheel pickers integrated seamlessly into the dark theme, highlighted by brandSecondary.

screens.name: Settings
screens.layout: Standard vertical list of settings categories (Personal, Activity, Theme, etc.). List items have 56pt height, left icon, title, and right chevron. The 'Appearance/Theme' sub-screen must show a horizontal list of 7 color swatches to change the app's primary hue.

screens.name: Hydration Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into water intake with a large visual.
screens.layout: Hero section: LARGE animated abstract water fill visual (use SVG clip paths or Lottie) that fills up as the user logs water. Displays '2.0L / 2.5L' inside. Below: Quick add glass buttons (+100ml, +200ml, +Glass). Bottom: History list and streak stats.

onboarding_shoe.alt: Nike running shoe with orange accents

hydration_water_bg.alt: Dark abstract water texture for hydration background

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a premium Android-first fitness app with a 'Dark-First Utility' personality mixed with high-end glassmorphism.
MANDATORY: Background is strictly #050505. Do not use pure black unless switching to the AMOLED Black theme.
MANDATORY: Cards must use dark glassmorphism. Implement this using expo-blur layered over a #121212 background with 28dp (lg) border radius.
MANDATORY: Circular Step Ring on the Home screen must be large and glowing. Use react-native-svg for the ring and apply shadow/drop-shadow effects for the neon glow.
MANDATORY: Support a 7-theme switcher in Settings. The default is Orange (#FF7A00). Design the architecture to allow swapping the primary/secondary/tertiary brand colors instantly.
MANDATORY: Bottom Navigation must have 5 tabs (Home, Steps, Workout, Habits, Body). The active tab icon should glow orange (using shadows).
For charts (Steps, Calories, Sleep), utilize react-native-gifted-charts with custom styling to match the neon/dark theme.
Use Rajdhani font for all large numbers, metrics, and display headers. Use Manrope for standard body text and labels.
In the Hydration detail screen, build a custom animated water fill visual (or use a masked view with an animated wave) to represent the 2.0L/2.5L progress.
Implement haptics on all major interactions: starting a workout, logging water, checking off a habit.
